immortalstorage.configuration.terminalRo: Preferred number of storage-terminal rows. The screen reduces it when the available height is insufficient. Default: 5. Range: 2-12.

Off gives uncapped storage and 256 Immortal Yuan every 20 ticks. On makes Immortal Yuan a non-consuming infinite resource. Default: off.

Maximum Refined Gathering Pills produced by one village loot roll.

Maximum Breakthrough Pills produced by one Nether loot roll.
